announcements.title: Welcome to the new home of Knight Warriors Club
announcements.body: Our official website is live — committee, members, events, rules and membership info, all in one place. Explore the sections and get to know your club.

announcements.title: Recruitment open — join the ranks
announcements.body: Knight Warriors Club is recruiting new members across eFootball, PUBG, Clash of Clans and Call of Duty. Pick your tier, fill in the application and become a Warrior.
